text:
Alice (AE): dropping the redlined MSA + short orderform from Kaleido POC. procurement wants net45, KMS attestation, and a clause for test data deletion after POC. attaching comments.
Maria - Legal: thx. quick Qs - is Kaleido classed as ‘regulated’ (HIPAA/PHI) or standard PII? which entity will sign (us or Redwood UK)?
Alice (AE): not HIPAA; they handle financial analytics (PII), US entity will sign. procurement asked for HSM-level attestations in the MSA.
Devon (SE): heads up: our hosted plan can offer KMS integration (customer-managed keys) but HSM attestation is only for Dedicated + HSM-backed KMS. we can offer a written attestation for key handling on Hosted, but not a hardware cert.
Raj (Presales): alternative: offer Dedicated trial for the POC with a short reserved window. keeps perf stable and meets attestation asks. adds cost though.
Chantal (Finance): net45 standard ok for enterprise POC, but need billing contact and PO number before countersign. Kaleido requested invoice to "Kaleido Corp, AP" and to ship after first monthly invoice.
Maria - Legal: seeing two redline hotspots: 1) SLA uptime & latency language (they want 99.99 for POC) 2) KMS/HSM warranty and indemnity language. also they added a new subproc clause for embeddings vendor — need vendor list.
Alice (AE): SLA ask is negotiable. they want a latency SLO for inference p95 < 150ms which is tight for hosted.
Devon (SE): p95 150ms only realistic on Dedicated in our benchmarks for LLMs at their scale. on Hosted we can promise p50/burst guarantees but not firm p95 without Dedicated. suggest: add fallback clause: we commit to throughput baseline and will route to Dedicated or compatible variant if latency breaches.
Maria - Legal: propose this compromise language: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet latency SLOs; where Customer requires firm p95 SLA, parties will agree a Dedicated deployment addendum." thoughts?
Alice (AE): fine. Kaleido procurement is also asking for signature routing: procurement -> legal (customer) -> exec sign at Redwood. they want an expedited countersign within 3 business days.
Chantal (Finance): for expedited countersign we need PO and billing contact + original signed orderform scanned. we can do e-sign. finance ok with that timeline if PO is in place.
Maria - Legal: okay to route: Sales (Alice) signs orderform -> Customer Legal -> Redwood Exec (Maria or VP commercial). we should flag exec approval for any >$150k commit.
ContractsBot: SUMMARY: Action items 
- Legal (Maria) to produce MSA response with Dedicated-addendum fallback and KMS attestation language (ETA 1 business day).
- SE (Devon) to provide documented perf matrix and short note on Dedicated trial cost (ETA EOD).
- Sales (Alice) to collect PO + billing contact from Kaleido and confirm signer names (ETA today).
- Finance (Chantal) to prepare invoice flow and note net45 terms for orderform (ETA EOD).
Alice (AE): I'll ping Kaleido procurement for PO and signer list now. cc @Raj will propose Dedicated trial as option.
Raj (Presales): will draft a short one-pager comparing Hosted vs Dedicated for the POC and include expected latencies/costs.
Maria - Legal: I'll draft the MSA reply and attach a DPA addendum. if they insist on HSM certs, we'll escalate to Product Security.
Devon (SE): attaching quick order snippet for clarity: 
```
OrderForm:
  Customer: Kaleido Inc
  POC term: 3 months
  Billing: Net45
  PO required before countersign
  Deployment: Hosted (default) / Dedicated (optional addendum)
  KMS: customer-managed keys (Hosted attestation) or Dedicated HSM attestation
  SLAs: latency SLO; dedicated p95 SLA requires Dedicated addendum
  Sign flow: Procurement -> Legal (Customer) -> Redwood Exec
```
Alice (AE): sounds good. everyone, please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the action plan.
Maria - Legal: :thumbsup:
Devon (SE): :thumbsup:
Chantal (Finance): :thumbsup:
Raj (Presales): :thumbsup:
Alice (AE): thanks — will report back once I have PO + signers.
